prompt.alinti: If you’re building modern websites in 2026, these animation libraries are worth knowing.
GSAP — Still the benchmark for complex timelines, scroll-driven experiences, and polished production animations.
Anime.js — Lightweight, flexible, and perfect when you want clean UI animations without a lot of setup.
Motion.dev — A favorite for React apps, with an intuitive API, smooth layout transitions, and built-in gesture support.
React Spring — Uses physics-based animations that feel natural, making interactive interfaces more fluid and responsive.
The right choice comes down to the kind of experience you’re building—not whatever happens to be trending.
If you want links to all of these resources, comment 'LINK' and I’ll send them over.
